u: qemu-io is a command line utility to exercise the QEMU I/O path.

-c, --cmd <cmd>
Command to execute
-r, --read-only
Export read-only
-s, --snapshot
Use snapshot file
-n, --nocache
Disable host cache
-g, --growable
Allow file to grow (only applies to protocols)
-m, --misalign
Misalign allocations for O_DIRECT
-k, --native-aio
Use kernel AIO implementation (on Linux only)
-h, --help
Display help and exit
-V, --version
Output version information and exit
